# mistershell_fact_collection_config (Data Source)

Reads existing backend-owned configuration without changing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_fact_collection_config" "existing" {
  id = var.fact_collection_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Existing numeric ID, stable configuration key, or local.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) configuration fields: is_enabled, display_order. ID is the catalog key. Masked secrets are returned as null.
